fields.name: CheckHours
fields.fieldText:
Make sure the operating hours of the user is within the operating hours of the call queue. Advice customer that if the call queue hour is outcide of the user hour setup for the extension. The user extension will show as unavailable. To check the hours for the call queue, log in as the Account Administrator and then go to the Phone System > Group(s) / Other(s) > then click on the name of the call queue. On the right side, click on "Call Queue Details" then click on the "Settings" tab within the said section. Click on "Edit" under "Business Hours"
To check the hours of the user while logged in as an administrator. Go to the "Users" tab > "User list" > "Users With Extensions". Click on the name of the user on the list. Click and expand the "User Details" section on the right and then click on "Settings and Permissions" in that section. Tou will be able to see the setup for the user hours by clicking on thne "Edit" button under the User Hours section.

fields.name: MembersAvailabilityStatus
fields.fieldText:
Members Availability Status
  • 1.Click on the "Phone System" tab.
  • 2. Click on Groups / Others in the left hand side panel.
  • 3. Click the Call Queues tab.
  • 4. Click the drop-down arrow on the far right of the Call Queue you want to check, just under the "Operation" column.
  • 5. The list of members will be displayed with their corresponding status under the "Member Availability" column..
Note:
  • Available - means the user's phone is available and awaiting a call. (In Rotating setup, the call will go to the user who has been in this status the longest.)
  • Busy - means the user is either on a call (inbound or outbound), or has set their line to Busy. Call queue users will not get calls from call queue while in this status.
  • Unavailable - means that a call queue member is currently outside their business hours, or has marked themselves as unavailable. If the user's status is set to DND (deskphone), or "Do not accept queue calls"/"Do not accept any calls" (mobile app / online account), or if the phone/computer is offline, it will also show as Unavailable. Call queue users will not get calls while in this status.
